Common Questions

Q1

Does SlideForge work offline?

Yes. The binary is fully self-contained — no API calls, no internet required after install.

Q2

Can I use custom fonts?

Define fonts in your design tokens JSON. SlideForge renders any font available in the headless Chromium environment.

Q3

What about accessibility?

All slides follow WCAG contrast ratios. The validator checks color contrast at build time.

Q4

Is there a Python SDK?

Not yet. The CLI and MCP server are the primary interfaces. Python integration works via subprocess calls.

Brand STORY · IMAGE · SOCIAL · CONVERSION

Pricing FAQ

Q1

Is there a free tier?

The CLI is open source and free forever.

Q2

What about enterprise support?

Email support, SLA guarantees, and custom integrations available on Pro and Enterprise plans.

Q3

Can I self-host?

Absolutely. The binary runs anywhere Rust compiles — Linux, macOS, Windows.
